title: Candidate conversion triage and buddy assignment - Mar 13 2026
content:
Meeting purpose: triage current pipeline -> decide who to convert / extend offers, coordinate buddy assignments for upcoming joiners, and capture any quick onboarding improvements we can ship this sprint.

Attendees: Avery (note-taker), Samir (recruiting lead), Maya (engineering manager, infra), Jules (platform-eng hiring coordinator), Noah (onboarding buddy program owner), Carmen Liu (was present for part of the sync).

Summary highlights:
- Pipeline snapshot (Mar 10): 18 active candidates in loop; 6 final-onsite / take-home in progress; 3 offer-ready (calibrations pending). Samir: we should prioritize 2 IC L4 backend hires and 1 SRE generalist.
- Interview feedback variability: interviewers are split on "system design" depth for L4 backend candidates -> need clearer rubric and exemplars. Current rubric link above is the canonical doc but it's not being used consistently.
- Buddy program: 5 incoming joiners in April/May; we only have 3 confirmed buddies. Noah to recruit 2 more and prepare a one-page buddy checklist.
- Onboarding friction: first-week infra sandbox provisioning is taking 48–72 hours on average for Private infra track. Action: escalate to infra-sre for gating points.

Detailed notes / debriefs (candidate-by-candidate):
- Candidate A (backend L4): strong coding problem, weak on capacity planning questions. Recommendation: move to final loop but add a 30-min ops/capacity mini-interview. Owner: Samir -> schedule. Decision status: proceed with additional probe.
- Candidate B (SRE generalist): excellent blameless postmortem discussion; flagged by two interviewers for limited experience with GPU infra. Recommendation: offer with expectation of cross-training; propose 8-week ramp plan. Owner: Maya -> draft ramp plan and include in offer.
- Candidate C (platform infra PM, internal ref): inconsistent rubric use caused split score (3 vs 4). Action: have Jules do a quick calibration chat with interviewers to align scoring. Decision status: hold for 48 hours.

Rubric and calibration action items:
- Short-term (this sprint): create 3 example transcripts / sample answers for L4 system design and SRE infra scenarios (Avery + Maya). Deadline: Mar 20.
- Medium-term: we need a lightweight rubric enforcement step in the ATS: when interviewers submit feedback, they must select 1–2 required competency tags (e.g., "design scaling", "incidents"). Samir to own a Jira story (INF-4399).

Buddy assignments + onboarding schedule:
- Incoming 04/06: Priya K. -> tentative buddy: Zoe K. (backend). Confirmation pending.
- Incoming 04/20: Miguel R. -> buddy: TBD. Noah to confirm by Mar 18.
- Incoming 05/04: two new grads -> need 2 buddies, prefer cross-team exposure. Noah to solicit volunteers in #eng-all.
- Buddy checklist (draft bullets): intro to team, codebase map + 2 small issues to fix, infra sandbox walkthrough, weekly 1:1 for first 6 weeks, intro to on-call rotation expectations (if applicable).

Onboarding tooling + infra blockers:
- Access provisioning (internal ticket flow): average completion: 2.4 days. Key blockers: missing manager approvals and KMS key grants for private deployments. Suggested mitigations: pre-approve default permissions for onboarding cohort and use an onboarding KMS key (rotate monthly). Owner: platform-eng -> Jules + infra-sre.
- Sandbox infra for Private deployment track: reproducible deployment script is outdated. Noah flagged a flaky terraform module (module: private-sandbox v1.2). Action: open PR to patch; link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/87 (work started). Priority: high for April joiners.

Team health signals observed:
- Pulse quick-check (informal): 3/10 people expressed concern about interview load and hiring noise. Common asks: more predictable interview templates, clearer "do not escalate" criteria, and more frontloaded reviewer training.
- Ramp velocity data (cohort hires): first 30 days productivity (measured as small merged PRs + onboarding tasks completed) drops 40% when buddy assignment delayed beyond week 1. This supports urgency to confirm buddies before start.
- Manager bandwidth: Maya and two EMs reported >20% time spent on hiring last month; risk of burnout. Suggest rota for final-stage interviews to avoid overloading the same EMs.

Decisions made in this sync:
1) Convert Candidate B to offer with a 30-day cross-training commitment and an 8-week ramp plan (owner Maya).
2) Proceed Candidate A to final loop with a targeted ops probe (owner Samir).
3) Confirm buddy assignments for April cohort by Mar 18; if not confirmed, rotate in "on-call backup buddies" list.

Action items (owners + deadlines):
- Samir: schedule additional ops mini-interview for Candidate A; create Jira INF-4399 for rubric enforcement story. Due: Mar 17.
- Noah: recruit 2 more buddies, publish buddy checklist one-pager, confirm April buddy by Mar 18. Due: Mar 18.
- Maya: draft 8-week ramp plan for SRE offer and include training milestones. Due: Mar 19.
- Jules + infra-sre: raise PR to fix private-sandbox terraform module and work with ops to reduce provisioning time for sandbox. Link PR in Confluence onboarding page. Due: Mar 24.
- Avery: produce 3 example interview transcripts for L4 / SRE scenarios and add to Interview Rubrics page. Due: Mar 20.

Open questions / risks:
- Compensation alignment: offer bands for L4 backend might be tight vs market. Finance check needed before sending two offers. Samir to coordinate with Recruiting Ops.
- On-call expectations for new hires on Private track need explicit opt-in; ambiguity creates anxiety. Recommend adding a checkbox in offer packet about on-call participation and training timeline.

Follow-ups / next meeting:
- Quick sync next Fri Mar 20 10:30am PST to review rubric exemplars and buddy confirmations.
- Full hiring retro planned end of quarter (Jun 1) to review conversion rates and ramp outcomes.

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep conversation short in #eng-hiring Friday update; call out urgent buddy gaps only.
- Reminder: stitch the PR links and Jira stories into Confluence page rather than leaving in Slack thread.

Attachments / references (copy these into Confluence after sync):
- Interview rubric link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/HR/Interview+Rubrics
- Current candidate tracker: JIRA query (saved): recruiterBoard: "Open Interviews - Eng"
- Ops PR in progress: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/87

End of notes.
